datasets.description: Parent experiment raw data: 480 paired (behavioral, structural) scores from Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT HS256 localhost, 8 co-occurring conditions x 60 samples, SEED=42

methodology.description: Frozen statistical reanalysis only. No new data collection. TOST equivalence test and Fisher z-transform CI on parent n=480 paired samples.
methodology.statistical_method: Fisher z-transform: z = 0.5*ln((1+r)/(1-r)), SE = 1/sqrt(n-3), CI = tanh(z +/- z_alpha * SE)
methodology.tost_method: Two one-sided tests at alpha=0.05 each: H0_lower: r <= -delta, H0_upper: r >= delta. Both must reject for equivalence.
methodology.decision_rule_ref: spec.json decision_rule — CI upper bound test

artifacts.description: TOST/CI analysis results, verified parent controls, delta-vs-sample-size trade-off
Human-readable report with tables and product consequences

reproduction_instructions: Load parent raw_evidence/experiment_data.json, extract all_behavioral_scores and all_structural_scores (480 paired values), compute Pearson r, Fisher z-transform, and TOST at delta in {0.10, 0.12, 0.15, 0.20}. All computation is deterministic given the raw data.
